svg.text: For design understanding and early scope coordination only.
Detailed fixing, connection, and installation information is excluded.

foreignObject.div: Project-specific GFRC/GRC decorative panels produced to custom design drawings — geometric patterns, calligraphy-inspired surfaces, or architectural identity elements at any scale.
Bespoke ornamental features — medallions, rosettes, keystones, and sculptural relief elements — cast in GRC/GFRC to project design intent and confirmed geometry.
Three-dimensional surface relief — geometric lattice, carved-effect patterns, and repeating ornamental textures produced in GRC/GFRC to any approved depth, profile, and pattern repeat.
Frame borders, edge profiles, and surround mouldings that define the decorative field — produced in GRC/GFRC to coordinate with both the panel geometry and surrounding facade elements.

svg.text: Custom Decorative Panel — project-specific surface element
Bespoke Ornament — medallion, rosette, or relief centrepiece
Relief Pattern — repeating ornamental surface texture
Edge Profile — border frame and surround moulding
Repeating Motif — coordinated pattern across panel field
Project-Specific Geometry — confirmed from design drawings
DURRAKA FACTORY FOR INDUSTRY — GRC/GFRC MANUFACTURING
